data.description:
One place for everything I make and learn. Projects, hardware notes, photos, a devlog and the things I am selling all live here, and I can add or change any of it from a private dashboard without touching code.

Every page has its own colour, and the home page is a full-screen photo you can switch between my own shots.
features: Separate sections for projects, tech lab, photography, listings and devlog
Private dashboard for adding and editing everything, with image uploads
A terminal, for those who prefer typing
Small tools in the playground, including a flip calculator and an exposure calculator
Theme Studio with 11 complete looks, saved per visitor
